bead.title: claude-tui: session pool keyed by workdir with /clear-between-turns reuse
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013 §3 (decision item 4) requires pooled long-lived PTY sessions keyed by (harness, workdir) with `/clear` issued between turns, so consecutive Execute calls sharing a working directory reuse the same warm PTY session instead of paying Ink+auth cold-start each turn.

ROOT CAUSE:
- internal/harnesses/claude-tui/harness.go:32-33 — the Harness struct has no fields and holds no session pool, so there is nowhere to cache a warm session.
- internal/harnesses/claude-tui/harness.go:53-57 — Execute calls `go h.runTurn(...)` for every request with no pool lookup, spawning a fresh PTY per turn and defeating reuse.
- internal/harnesses/claude-tui/harness.go:60-79 — runTurn never writes `/clear` and never reuses a session; it only emits a stub Final event.
- internal/pty/session/types.go:176 — the Session type exposes no Pid() accessor (the pid lives only at internal/pty/session/session_unix.go:126 as `u.cmd.Process.Pid`), so session reuse cannot be asserted by pid identity.

PROPOSED FIX:
1. Add a package-scope session-pool singleton in internal/harnesses/claude-tui/ keyed by (harness, workdir) at depth 1 per key, placed at package scope rather than as a Harness/Runner field (ADR-013 §3 item 4 pool-placement rule), so two Harness instances share the pool. On Execute, look up an existing session for the workdir or open a new one via internal/pty/session.Start.
2. Between consecutive turns sharing a key, write `/clear` to the session and confirm the CLI acknowledged the clear (ready marker re-appears) before injecting the next prompt.
3. Add a Session.Pid() accessor in internal/pty/session exposing `u.cmd.Process.Pid` so reuse can be verified by pid identity.

NON-SCOPE:
- The shutdown orphan reaper (sibling child in this decomposition).
- The PTY turn driver and intermediate ProgressEvent emission (sibling child A).
- AccountHarness and QuotaHarness implementations (sibling child C).
- Performance benchmarking and 2x/10ms ratchets (sibling child D).
- ModelDiscoveryHarness and no-static-fallback enforcement.
- Capability baseline rows, evidence IDs, ADR-013 status promotion.
- Cassette-driven static fallback for production code (forbidden by fizeau-89eca738).
- Service-side changes beyond what child #1 already wired.
- Redesigning the hook-conflict arbitration layer.

Depends on child #1 and sibling child A. Governing artifacts: ADR-013 §3 (decision item 4), CONTRACT-004, internal/pty/ library.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestClaudeTuiSessionPoolReusesAndClears asserts `/clear` is issued between consecutive turns sharing a working directory and that the underlying PTY session is reused (same pid, observed via Session.Pid()).
2) go test ./... -count=1 is green.
3) lefthook run pre-commit is green.
